notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update Information
notes.content:
- Regarding volume adjustment, when the sound is changed from a muted state to a sound with sound, the sound is played immediately.
- Fixed a bug that caused the turn to end without the "Board" command being displayed when adjacent to both enemy and friendly bases after moving the player's ship.
- Other minor changes have been made to the messages displayed during the game.

notes.title: Sidereal Wanderer gone gold
notes.content:
Hello, 
Good news for all gaming fans waiting for the release of Sidereal Wanderer. We are happy to announce that we have completed the game and submitted review the build to Steam.

The game will be released on April 23rd. Please note, however, that there may be a delay depending on the status of the submission of the build. The game will be priced at USD 5.99 and a launch sale is planned.

Sidereal Wanderer" pays homage to the strategy games of the 1970s. The player must take a single spaceship into enemy-controlled space and destroy enemy ships and bases.

Players who don't know the rules or how to pilot a spaceship will probably find themselves jumping aimlessly into the vastness of space, running out of energy, running out of crew strength, or falling prey to the enemy.

In order to avoid going from space warrior to space stranger, we recommend that you carefully read the manual for this game before the game's release. The manual is linked from the product page. Please read it before playing the game.

Please look forward to the release of the game.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2842790/
